scripts.dev: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run --filter @hydra/web dev; else npm run dev --workspace=@hydra/web; fi
scripts.build: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run --filter @hydra/web build && bun run --filter @hydra/chrome-extension build; else npm run build --workspace=@hydra/web --workspace=@hydra/chrome-extension; fi
scripts.test: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test apps/web/src apps/chrome-extension/src; else npm run test --workspace=@hydra/web; fi
scripts.test:e2e: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run --filter @hydra/web test:e2e; else npm run test:e2e --workspace=@hydra/web; fi
scripts.typecheck: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run --filter @hydra/web typecheck && bun run --filter @hydra/chrome-extension typecheck; else npm run typecheck --workspace=@hydra/web --workspace=@hydra/chrome-extension; fi
scripts.lint: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run typecheck; else npm run typecheck; fi
